simple.meaning: מַהְפֵּכָה (mahpêkâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a destruction.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַהְפֵּכָה (H4114) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 29:22, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Amos.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַהְפֵּכָה (H4114) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַהְפֵּכָה (H4114) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַהְפֵּכָה (mahpêkâh) / H4114 is traced through Deuteronomy 29:22, Isaiah 1:7, Isaiah 13:19, Jeremiah 49:18 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4114. mahpekah [ מַהְמֵּכָה ] noun feminine overthrow — always construct מַהְמֵּכַת ; & always of overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah etc., except Isa 1:7 ׳מ זָרִים , where read סְדֹם (Ew Che RS Proph. 345 Di and others; also Lag Semitic i. 3 ); yet even so probably gloss, compare Stu JPTh 1877, 714 ; ׳מ סְדֹם Deut 29:22 ; Jer 49:18 ; and with force of verbal noun, governing accusative, ׳מ אתסֿדם אלהים Isa 13:19 ; Jer 50:40 ; Amos 4:11 . compare also הָפַךְ 1b , הֲפֵכָה .
